item.title: Senior accused in Chatham apartment fire returns to court Feb. 3
item.description: A Chatham senior accused of arson after a fire at a Chatham housing complex last week now has a lawyer and a bail plan in the works.

item.title: Local hockey: Konecny top scorer on Flyers; Kings' Graham leading PJHL
item.description: Clachan’s Travis Konecny leads the Philadelphia Flyers in goals (21), assists (29) and points (50) after collecting five points in his last two games.

item.title: Local roundup: Josling on national stage; Carleton top scorer; Nicholas in Singapore
item.description: William Josling of the Chatham Skating Club is going to the Skate Canada Trophy competition that starts Thursday in Dartmouth, N.S.

item.title: SIU clears Chatham-Kent officer after man hurt himself during standoff
item.description: Ontario’s police watchdog has cleared a Chatham-Kent police officer after a man seriously injured himself during a standoff last fall.

item.title: Drug overdoses, reactions up, Chatham-Kent Public Health warns
item.description: The health unit is alerting the public about an increase in drug overdoses and unexpected reactions to substances in the municipality

item.title: Facing eviction: tenants prepared to fight for right to stay in homes
